sources.label: 🥀 Brokenn patches for apps I love
sources.author: Brokenn
patch_list: Skips the network interface check that blocks the app on a VPN or proxy.
Turns off Firebase Analytics collection and Crashlytics reporting.
Skips the launch version check that shows the update dialog.
Removes banner, native, interstitial and rewarded ads.
Removes phone state, advertising id, install referrer and badge permissions.
Treats the app as signed in and never shows the login screen.
